description: This file implements a NetLink class for managing netlink socket communication on Linux, including opening, closing, sending requests, and receiving messages.

classes.name: NetLink
classes.description: A class for managing netlink socket communication, including opening, closing, requesting, and retrieving messages.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a netlink socket with specified type and protocol.

methods.name: IsOpened
methods.description: Checks if the netlink socket is open.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Sends a netlink request with specified type, flags, payload, and payload length.

methods.name: GetNextMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the next netlink message, or nullptr if no more messages.
